answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a relic as the anchor of the cost.
